name: Yuugu ~Nyomitsu Gangu Adesugata~
source:
Our hero is a sophomore and member of the Occult Study Group at his school.  One day he is handed a book that changes his world...

[Quick description taken from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=136241]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主角是二年級學生，也是學校神秘學研究會的成員。一天，他得到了一本改變了他的世界的書……
